regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, metadata, and introductory text
regions.finding: Verified the full article title and current Cu-catalyzed 1,4-alkylcyanation claim. The abstract is an aggregate reaction-class statement rather than an experiment-specific run; cited alkoxy-radical and 1,3-enyne literature was not promoted to current-paper experiments.

Classified Scheme 1a as cited fused-bicycle cleavage context, Scheme 1b as the authors' cited prior aminocarbonylation, and Scheme 1c as the current generic alkylcyanation class. None was assigned a Scheme 2 row yield.

unresolved: Scheme 1 uses generic R/n/FG groups and does not define experiment-specific structures or quantities.
No workspace SI association is established.

regions.finding: Recorded the explicit 74% initial model experiment and the L4 'totally ineffective' row. The optimized 2.0-equiv/86% result is merged with Scheme 2 product 3aa. Other Table S1 salts/solvents/ligand rows and the unshown no-copper control lack main-text row values and were not fabricated.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Scheme 2 complete product grid and caption
regions.finding: Recorded all 22 distinct hydroperoxide-scope arrows, including 3aa–3ua and regioselective 3aa', with shared exact charges/loadings/volume, room temperature, 12 h, N2, isolated yields, 1:1 dr, and stated dr analytical basis.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Scheme 3 complete product grid and caption
regions.finding: Recorded all 16 distinct enyne-scope arrows 3ab–3aq with shared exact charges/loadings/volume, room temperature, 12 h, N2, isolated yields, 1:1 dr, and stated analytical basis. The discussion continues on page 3 and was linked rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Table S1 is only cited and not associated; omitted optimization identities/values and the unshown no-copper control cannot be reconstructed.
Scope rows omit workup, purification, isolated masses, and safely complete encodings for compact structures.

regions.finding: Linked the 3ab–3aq substituent discussion and polarity-mismatch interpretation to the existing Scheme 3 records without creating prose duplicates.
Recorded the distinct Fe(OTf)2/1,10-Phen/TMSN3/MeOH alkylazidation to 4aa (83%, dr 1:1) at room temperature for 12 h.

Recorded the independent 3.0 mmol model scale-up to 3aa and four distinct derivatizations to 5aa, 6aa, 7aa, and 8aa. Every printed reagent loading/equivalent/solvent volume or ratio, temperature, time, atmosphere, yield, and dr was retained.
Recorded four independent controls: TEMPO and BHT at 2.0 equiv (3aa 32% and 10%), no-ligand 'nr', and preformed Cu(I) complex C1 at 5 mol% (3aa 67%). HRMS values for TEMPO adduct 9a were retained.
Classified I–VIII and radicals III–VI as a proposed catalytic mechanism. Printed HRMS m/z values for complexes II, VII, and VIII are characterization observations, not independent preparations.

unresolved: Scheme 4–6 omit several absolute scales, solvent volumes, workups, purifications, masses, measurement bases, and detection limits.
The scale-up's 3.0 mmol denominator is not explicitly assigned to a particular charged reactant.
Mechanistic intermediates remain proposed and machine-unverified.
